question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** Has.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 1
 
• Has is a grammatical variation of the verb have. Has is used in the present tense with any third-person singular noun, including he, she, it, and others.
 
• Thus the correct answer is Has.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• We can use these sentences to illustrate possession of the **location, goods, physical circumstances,** and **relationships as well.**

 
 
• **​Example - **Shalu **has** soft skin.
 
• He **has** a nice garden in his yard.
